etymology: a primitive root meaning to push aside
avSummary: cast...off 17, cast away 1, turn...away 1, removed...far off
definition:
1) to cast off, reject, spurn
    1a) (Qal) to reject
    1b) (Hiphil) to forcefully reject someone
 2) to stink, emit stench, become odious
    2a) (Hiphil) stink (perfect)
